<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 6"
    pfs="Restricted"
>
[Cloaking Pulse](/Feats.aspx?ID=5455) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 70

**Archetype** [Ostilli Host](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=222)

**Prerequisites**
[Ostilli Host Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5451)

</column>

---

Your ostilli can emit illusion magic to mask your position, granting you the Drape Ambient Magic action.

 **Drape Ambient Magic** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629)) **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** Your ostilli turns clear as it converts its stored magic into a bubble of refracting light around you. You become [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79) to all creatures until the end of your turn. If you Strike a creature, that creature is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) against that attack, and you then become [observed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=84).
name: Cloaking Pulse
